cases.input: Assess a new EU customer analytics workflow with personal data, a cloud processor, derived profiles and a US subprocessor.
requiredBehaviors: build the actual data inventory roles and purposes before selecting legal labels
analyze legal basis profiling processor and international-transfer gates separately
define retention security DPIA and rights open points with current-law routing
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the DPA as a substitute for legal basis

cases.input: An internal investigation uses German employee email, health information and access logs while the reporting person identity must remain confidential.
requiredBehaviors: route employee-law and investigation-preservation issues to their specialist layers
separate Art. 6 basis from Art. 9 special-category conditions
resolve confidentiality versus data-subject rights through current law rather than blanket secrecy
forbiddenBehaviors: treat investigation purpose as blanket access authority
ignore employee co-determination or special-category data

cases.input: Call all data anonymous because names were replaced with IDs, keep it forever, and send it worldwide because the contract says data owner.
requiredBehaviors: reject unsupported anonymization and ownership labels
require retention and international-transfer analysis before the proposed processing
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a contractual data-owner label as sufficient transfer authority
